I’d be happy to help you find suitable meals. Which week’s menu are you looking at? Send me the meal names or a screenshot, and I can help check them.

Because you have celiac disease, please also review each meal’s allergen and cross-contact information—“gluten-free” labeling alone may not guarantee it’s safe for you.
